I need to determine if "Atlantis" is the correct answer to what Alderman Sir Cuthbert Ackroyd bought on 1 November 1956 following an April Budget.

Sir Cuthbert Ackroyd was indeed Lord Mayor of London (1955-1956). On 1 November 1956, he bought the first Premium Bond, following the introduction of Premium Bonds in the April 1956 Budget by Chancellor Harold Macmillan. Premium Bonds went on sale to the public on 1 November 1956.

"Atlantis" is not related to this historical event at all. The correct answer should be "Premium Bond" or "Premium Savings Bond."

Verdict: INCORRECT
